entities.name: Fabio Martínez Castilla
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fabio Martínez Castilla was a Mexican Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Ciudad Lázaro Cárdenas from 2007 to 2013 and archbishop of Tuxtla from 2013 until his death. He died due to ischemic crisis and neoplasm in Tuxtla Gutiérrez, Chiapas, on 25 November 2023, at the age of 73.
